subject: done S11 (rework D1-D8)
body:
S11 rework (review 20261117T005225-review11-0e1b08): D1-D8 fixed, integrated as 6d06147 on claude/naadi-shared.

Tests
- Integrate gate (lint, typecheck, vitest, pytest -m "not live and not db"): pass, 840 pytest.
- Local db suite (all `db and not live`): 374 passed, 1 skipped. vitest: web 268, ui 27, shared 125, ink 66.
- e2e smoke (today.spec + shell.spec, webkit ipad portrait/landscape/phone-390 + chromium-laptop-1440), --retries=0: 84/84, twice.
- CI run 143: https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/43995510789
  - lint/typecheck/unit/drift/models/build: green. integration (db): green.
  - e2e chromium: today.spec 42/42 green. 2 failures, both ink-sync.spec:310 (S12b).
  - e2e webkit: today.spec 42/42 green. 1 failure: exam.spec:341 offline timer, webkit-ipad-landscape (S09).
  - e2e firefox: still running at posting time.
  - The green ✘ marks are console-guard's expected failures.
- Screenshots (iPad portrait/landscape, phone, laptop): test-results/screens/11/ (welcome-empty/filled/too-short, today-first-day/diagnostic/coach/coach-why/ticked/offline, diagnostic-start).

D1-D8
- D1: plan.max_study_days=180 (PlanRules, ge 21, le 366). The generator raises too_many_days {days, allowed} before any work. PUT /api/onboarding returns 422 too_many_days on body.exam_date before any write. The preview returns problem too_many_days plus max_days. The date input max is today+max. New copy onboarding.preview_too_far and onboarding.save_too_far. Tests: generator at 180/181/2999; db PUT/preview at 180 OK, 181 refused with nothing written; e2e checks the picker max and the too-far text.
- D2: numbers_in_text matches digits anywhere (Q99, a20, 1.5, 1,000), number words (zero-ninety, hundred, thousand, million), half/quarter, double/twice/triple/thrice/treble/quadruple, dozen, score, ordinals third-twentieth, and canonical multi-letter roman numerals. Any value not in the facts drops the suggestion. 13 parametrized unit cases plus a reply-level test.
- D3: migration 0014 adds the partial unique index blocks_one_open_diagnostic (user_id) where purpose='diagnostic' and finished_at is null. Existing duplicate open diagnostics lose their purpose tag first. create_diagnostic catches UniqueViolation and returns the winner's block with 200. db test: 6 concurrent POSTs give one 201, five 200s and one block.
- D4: every coach call carries run_id coach:<local date>. Before calling, the pass checks llm_usage for (user, run_id); the gateway reserves a row per attempt. If tonight's llm rows exist they are left untouched and there is no call. If an attempt was made but there are no llm rows, rules are used and there is no call. budget_spent is set only on reason daily_cap; rate_limited and turn_limit give rules to that student only (the gateway's bounded rate_wait_s applies first). Tests: unit (rate_limited and turn_limit), db (three runs in one night, one call).
- D5: study_plans.last_coached_at (0014, plus a partial index). Students are ordered by last_coached_at nulls first, then user_id. The column is stamped whenever a student is examined. db test with max_users_per_run=1 rotates through B (never coached), then A.
- D6: materials_legend reads "What you already use". next_diagnostic reads "Next: a {n}-question diagnostic that shows where you stand in each system."
- D7: the Today "Now" chip uses the new Chip tone `current` (neutral solid outline, the word stays). The e2e limeCount scans every visible element, excluding only the brand logo disc (data-brand-mark) and listing any extras in the log. Today has exactly 1 lime.
- D8a: the rest day's target hours are min(template, daily_hours) (unit test).
- D8b: ReadinessOut.days comes from coach.readiness_days; the caption reads "...in the last {days} days".
- D8c: trigger coach_suggestions_status_guard (naadi_coach_status_guard, search_path='', not client-executable). Status leaves 'new' once and never changes again, for every role. `authenticated` may only set 'dismissed'; accepting goes through the API, which adds the items in the same transaction. db test covers client accept refused, accepted->new/dismissed refused, dismissed->new refused, and a second accept adding no items.
- D8d: a successful onboarding runs one as_service transaction: save_profile, then write_plan, then completed_at.
- D8e: on a first onboarding the client sends the Intl time zone as `timezone` in the PUT and `tz` in the preview. The server validates it and saves it with the answers. db test with America/Chicago and an invalid zone.

Decisions
- Migration 0014 is the single head. db/schema.sql and test_migrate are updated, and the functions list in test_rls_coverage includes the trigger function.
- Shared-file touches, both additive: packages/ui Chip gains the `current` tone (the existing lime `now` tone is unchanged for SystemPage), and shell Logo gains data-brand-mark.
- The single retry on malformed model output stays inside the one nightly attempt, so an attempt is at most 2 calls. If the lead wants strictly 1 call, dropping the retry is a one-line change.
